title: coreJ split-storage rule documentation sidecar
description: One rule's citation prose, at rules-src/docs/<FAMILY>/<Core.Id>.yaml: the bulky Cited_Guidance / Document / Item / Section text lifted out of the check file's Standards block, keyed per reference by its locator Organization|Name|Version|Substandard|Rule_Identifier.Id|Rule_Identifier.Version[#n] so the assembler (AuthoredRuleAssembler) can re-attach it. Never read by the execution engine; released packages drop citations. YAML on disk; validates as JSON Schema after parsing.

Core.description: The Core.Id of the check file this sidecar documents (rules-src/checks/<FAMILY>/<Core.Id>.yaml); the two are joined by it.

Citations.description: The citations per reference of the check's Standards block, keyed by its locator Organization|Name|Version|Substandard|Rule_Identifier.Id|Rule_Identifier.Version (an absent part empty; #1, #2, ... on a repeated key). The generator re-attaches them to the matching reference; a key matching no reference is ignored, and released packages drop citations with the collapsed Authorities.

Cited_Guidance.description: The quoted text of the cited Document - an IG passage, or the published rule's own text for a validator / conformance-rule document - or null.

Document.description: The document the citation is taken from, e.g. "IG v3.4", or null.

Item.description: The item within the document (a table, a variable, a rule number), or null.

Section.description: The section of the document, e.g. "4.4.4" - or, for a validator-rule document, the business or conformance rule id it cites (FDAB011, CG0456) - or null.
